name: firestorm-bridge
description: This add-on integrates OpenSim AI Stack with Firestorm MCP (https://github.com/AochiToxx/firestorm-mcp). Note, you have to install and run Firestorm MCP yourself according to it's instructions. You must run it in streamable HTTP or SSE mode and set this add-on configuration after it is enableed.

configuration.name: FIRESTORM_MCP_HOST
configuration.description: The host where the Firestorm MCP server will be running,  i.e. your viewer. This should be your computer's IP address.

configuration.name: FIRESTORM_MCP_ENDPOINT
configuration.description: The endpoint where the Firestorm MCP server will be accessible. Recommended be /mcp for streamable-http modee.

configuration.name: FIRESTORM_MCP_PORT
configuration.description: The port where the Firestorm MCP server will be running. This should be 8000.

configuration.name: FIRESTORM_MCP_API_KEY
configuration.description: If the MCP requires an authentication token (recommended), provide it here. Otherwise leave blank.
